sesotho_text: Joalokaha bochaba-tsatsi bo le hōle le bophirima-tsatsi, Ka ho tšoanang o suthiselitse litlōlo tsa rōna hōle le rōna.
english_text: As far as the sunrise is from the sunset, so far has he put our transgressions far away from us.

sesotho_text: ...ea batlang tlhompho, le mo fe tlhompho e joalo.
english_text: ...to the one who calls for honor, such honor.

sesotho_text: ...ea batlang tšabo, le mo fe tšabo e joalo.
english_text: ...to the one who calls for fear, such fear.

sesotho_text: Molimo a bitsa sepakapaka Leholimo. Ea e-ba mantsiboea ’me ea e-ba hoseng, letsatsi la bobeli.
english_text: God called the expanse Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.

sesotho_text: Tšimolohong Molimo o ile a bōpa maholimo le lefatše.
english_text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

sesotho_text: Joale lefatše le ne le se na sebōpeho ebile le se na letho ’me lefifi le ne le le holim ’a boliba; matla a sebetsang a Molimo a ne a e-ea koana le koana holim ’a metsi.
english_text: Now the earth was formless and desolate, and there was darkness upon the surface of the watery deep, and God’s active force was moving about over the surface of the waters.

sesotho_text: Molimo a re: “Leseli le ke le be teng.” Joale leseli la e-ba teng.
english_text: And God said: “Let there be light.” Then there was light.

sesotho_text: Molimo a bitsa leseli Motšehare, empa lefifi a le bitsa Bosiu. Ea e-ba mantsiboea ’me ea e-ba hoseng, letsatsi la pele.
english_text: God called the light Day, but the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, a first day.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Ho ke ho be le sepakapaka pakeng tsa metsi ’me ho ke ho be le karohano pakeng tsa metsi le metsi.”
english_text: Then God said: “Let there be an expanse between the waters, and let there be a division between the waters and the waters.”

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Metsi a ka tlas’a maholimo a ke a bokelloe sebakeng se le seng ’me ho ke ho hlahe naha e omileng.” ’Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let the waters under the heavens be collected together into one place, and let the dry land appear.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Eaba Molimo o bōpa liphoofolo tsa litonanahali tsa leoatle le moea o mong le o mong o phelang o tsamaeang, tseo metsi a li hlahisitseng ka bongata ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona, le sebōpuoa se seng le se seng se fofang se nang le mapheo ho ea ka mofuta oa sona. ’Me Molimo a bona hore ho molemo.
english_text: And God created the great sea creatures and all living creatures that move and swarm in the waters according to their kinds and every winged flying creature according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Lefatše le ke le hlahise joang, limela tse behang peō, lifate tsa litholoana tse behang litholoana ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona, tseo peō ea tsona e leng ho tsona, holim ’a lefatše.” ’Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let the earth cause grass to sprout, seed-bearing plants and fruit trees according to their kinds, yielding fruit along with seed on the earth.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Ho ke ho be le mehloli ea leseli sepakapakeng sa maholimo.
english_text: Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Ho ke ho be le mehloli ea leseli sepakapakeng sa maholimo ho etsa karohano pakeng tsa motšehare le bosiu; ’me e tla ba lipontšo le linako tsa selemo le matsatsi le lilemo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let there be luminaries in the expanse of the heavens to make a division between the day and the night, and they will serve as signs for seasons and for days and years.

sesotho_text: Molimo a etsa mehloli e ’meli e meholo ea leseli, mohloli o moholo oa leseli bakeng sa ho laola motšehare le mohloli o monyenyane oa leseli bakeng sa ho laola bosiu, le linaleli.
english_text: And God went on to make the two great luminaries, the greater luminary for dominating the day and the lesser luminary for dominating the night, and also the stars.

sesotho_text: Libōpuoa tse fofang li ke li fofe holim 'a lefatše.
english_text: Let birds fly above the earth.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “Lefatše le ke le hlahise meea e phelang ho ea ka mefuta ea eona, phoofolo e ruuoang le phoofolo e hahabang le sebata sa lefatše ho ea ka mofuta oa sona.” ’Me ha e-ba joalo.
english_text: Then God said: “Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds, domestic animals and creeping animals and wild animals of the earth according to their kinds.” And it was so.

sesotho_text: Molimo a tsoela pele ho re: “A re etse motho ka setšoantšo sa rōna, ho ea ka sebōpeho sa rōna, ’me ba laole litlhapi tsa leoatle le libōpuoa tse fofang tsa maholimo le liphoofolo tse ruuoang le lefatše lohle le phoofolo e ’ngoe le e ’ngoe e hahabang lefatšeng.”
english_text: Then God said: “Let us make man in our image, according to our likeness, and let them have in subjection the fish of the sea and the flying creatures of the heavens and the domestic animals and all the earth and every creeping animal that is moving on the earth.”

sesotho_text: Molimo a bōpa motho ka setšoantšo sa hae, a mo bōpa ka setšoantšo sa Molimo; a ba bōpa e le e motona le e motšehali.
english_text: And God went on to create the man in his image, in God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

sesotho_text: Ka mor’a moo Molimo a bona hore leseli le molemo, ’me Molimo a hlahisa karohano pakeng tsa leseli le lefifi.
english_text: After that God saw that the light was good, and God began to divide the light from the darkness.

sesotho_text: Empa ha moea o foka, ea nyamelaJoalokaha eka ha e e-s'o ka e e-ba teng.
english_text: But when a wind blows, it is no more,As though it was never there.

sesotho_text: Ka mor'a moo Molimo a bona hore leseli le molemo, 'me Molimo a hlahisa karohano pakeng tsa leseli le lefifi.
english_text: After that God saw that the light was good, and God began to divide the light from the darkness.

sesotho_text: Feela joalokaha bochabela bo le hole le bophirimela,Ka ho tšoanang o suthiselitse liphoso tsa rona hole le rona.
english_text: As far off as the sunrise is from the sunset,So far off from us he has put our transgressions.

sesotho_text: Molimo a hlohonolofatsa letsatsi la bosupa 'me a re lea halalela hobane letsatsing leo o ile a phomola ka mor'a mosebetsi oohle oo a o entseng.
english_text: And God went on to bless the seventh day and to declare it sacred, for on it God has been resting from all the work that he has created, all that he purposed to make.

sesotho_text: Jehova o mohau 'me o na le kutloelo-bohloko,O lieha ho halefa ebile o lerato.
english_text: Jehovah is merciful and compassionate,Slow to anger and abundant in loyal love.

sesotho_text: Lebitso la noka ea pele ke Pishone. Ke eona e potolohileng naha eohle ea Havila, e nang le khauta.
english_text: The name of the first is Piʹshon; it is the one encircling the entire land of Havʹi·lah, where there is gold.

sesotho_text: Molimo a qeta ho bopa maholimo le lefatše le lintho tsohle tse ho tsona.
english_text: Thus the heavens and the earth and everything in them were completed.

sesotho_text: Monna le mosali oa hae ba ile ba lula ba sa apara. Leha ho le joalo, ba ne ba sa hlajoe ke lihlong.
english_text: And both of them continued to be naked, the man and his wife; yet they were not ashamed.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a melisa lifate tsohle tse ntle le tseo litholoana tsa tsona li ka jeoang a ba a melisa sefate sa bophelo hammoho le sefate sa tsebo ea botle le bobe har'a serapa.
english_text: Thus Jehovah God made to grow out of the ground every tree that was pleasing to look at and good for food and also the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and bad.

sesotho_text: Eaba Molimo o bōpa liphoofolo tsa litonanahali tsa leoatle le moea o mong le o mong o phelang o tsamaeang, tseo metsi a li hlahisitseng ka bongata ho ea ka mefuta ea tsona, le sebōpuoa se seng le se seng se fofang se nang le mapheo ho ea ka mofuta oa sona. 'Me Molimo a bona hore ho molemo.
english_text: And God created the great sea creatures and all living creatures that move and swarm in the waters according to their kinds and every winged flying creature according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

sesotho_text: Rorisang Jehova, lona mabotho 'ohle a hae,Lona basebeletsi ba hae, ba etsang thato ea hae.
english_text: Praise Jehovah, all his armies,His ministers who do his will.

sesotho_text: Jehova o tšoara bohle ba hateletsoeng ka tokaLe ka tsela e lokileng.
english_text: Jehovah acts with righteousness and justiceFor all who are oppressed.

sesotho_text: Molimo a phomola ka letsatsi la bosupa mosebetsing oohle oa hae.
english_text: And He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.

sesotho_text: Empa moholi o ne o nyoloha lefatšeng 'me o nosetsa lefatše lohle.
english_text: But a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a etsa motho ka lerōle la lefatše.
english_text: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground.

sesotho_text: A bululela linkong tsa hae phefumoloho ea bophelo.
english_text: And breathed into his nostrils the breath of life.

sesotho_text: Ka tseo maholima le lefatše li phethahala, le mokhatlo oohle oa ona.
english_text: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their host.

sesotho_text: Ka letsatsi la bobeli Molimo a phetha mosebetsi oa hae.
english_text: By the second day God finished His work.

sesotho_text: Molimo a halaletsa letsatsi la bosupa.
english_text: God sanctified the seventh day.

sesotho_text: Ha ho a ba le sehlahla sa naha hofatše.
english_text: No shrub of the field was yet in the earth.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a etsa motho ka lerōle la mobu.
english_text: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the soil.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a lema serapa Edene, ka ng'a bochabela.
english_text: The LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden.

sesotho_text: Joale Jehova Molimo a mela le sefate sohle se khabisehang lefatšeng.
english_text: The LORD God made to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight.

sesotho_text: ...le sefate sa tsebo ea molemo le bokhopo.
english_text: ...and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

sesotho_text: Joale ho ne ho e-na le nōka e tsoang Edene ho nosetsa serapa seo.
english_text: Now a river went out of Eden to water the garden.

sesotho_text: ...naha eohle ea Havila, moo ho nang le khauta.
english_text: ...the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.

sesotho_text: ...le lejoe la oli le lijoe tsa topaze.
english_text: ...and the onyx stone and the stone of beryl.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a nka motho a mo beha serapeng sa Edene ho se lema.
english_text: Then the LORD God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to tend it.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a nka motho a mo beha serapeng sa Edene ho se lema le ho se hlokomela.
english_text: The LORD God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to tend and keep it.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a boela a laela motho sena.
english_text: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying...

sesotho_text: Ke tla mo etsetsa mothusi, e be motlatsi oa hae.
english_text: I will make him a helper comparable to him.

sesotho_text: Ke tla mo etsetsa mothusi, e be motlatsi oa hae.
english_text: I will make him a helper, a complement for him.

sesotho_text: O qala ho li tlisa ho motho ho bona hore na se seng le se seng sa tsona o tla se reha eng.
english_text: And brought them to Adam to see what he would call them.

sesotho_text: Jehova Molimo a etsa monna a robale boroko bo boholo.
english_text: The LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall on the man.

sesotho_text: A nka e 'ngoe ea likhopo tsa hae 'me sebakeng sa eona a koala ka nama.
english_text: And He took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

sesotho_text: Eaba Jehova Molimo o etsa mosali ka khopo eo a e nkileng ho monna.
english_text: Then the rib which the LORD God had taken from man He made into a woman.

sesotho_text: Qetellong enoa ke lesapo la masapo a ka.
english_text: This is now bone of my bones.

sesotho_text: Ka hona monna o tla siea ntata hae le 'mae 'me o tla khumamelana le mosali oa hae.
english_text: Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and be joined to his wife.
